text: Delivered in merge fc19f4a (commits 476c857, c5a3fe1); fresh-context review found no blockers; root aggregate 2,290 tests green on JVM and JS, isolated consumer 16+16. Basic coordinate-transform conformance is pinned: tools/r-parity/transforms.R drives eyesim center/rescale/normalize on four points (one off the bounds diagonal), an exact rational oracle covers the supplied affine, fixture transforms.json sha 89d04fa3ef04d2320a6b0a24315b5e6f4af6982243093fc491b39fd07acc570a is pinned in baseline.json, and core TransformConformanceSuite pins the values. baseline row basic-coordinate-transforms is verified-equivalent. Residual (this ticket, now p3): eyesim affine_transform and contract_transform are fitted density-space maps applied by bilinear resampling and error on coordinate tables; eyes4s does not implement them (baseline row fitted-density-transforms, implementation-gap).
